# dayli.ai

> dayli is an AI-powered Climate Health Copilot for women and children. It combines local climate data, health knowledge, and AI personalization to deliver real-time, actionable guidance over WhatsApp.

## What dayli is

- An AI Climate Health Copilot, delivered through WhatsApp (no app to download).
- Built for pregnant women, mothers, and caregivers of young children — populations most vulnerable to extreme heat and climate-driven health risks.
- Free to use. Onboarding takes under a minute on WhatsApp.
- Currently piloting with maternal and pediatric clinics in Hyderabad, India.

## What dayli is not

- Not a medical device.
- Not a chatbot or generic wellness app.
- Does not replace professional medical advice. For emergencies, contact your local healthcare provider.

## How dayli works

1. **Understands you** — learns your pregnancy stage or your child's age, and your daily location.
2. **Monitors climate risk** — tracks heatwaves, temperature spikes, and environmental stress in real time using WHO heat thresholds, the India Meteorological Department (IMD), and OpenWeather.
3. **Guides you daily** — sends hydration reminders, safe outdoor timing, alerts, and check-ins on WhatsApp.

## Who dayli serves

- **Individuals**: pregnant women, mothers, caregivers of young children.
- **Clinics**: maternal and pediatric clinics looking to reduce no-shows and improve patient outcomes.
- **Pharma & life sciences**: companies seeking to improve medication adherence in real-world climate conditions.

## Privacy

- dayli only collects the information needed to provide safe guidance: WhatsApp number, pregnancy stage or child's age, approximate location, and daily check-in responses.
- Your data is never sold. It is never used for advertising.
- Individual health data is never shared with clinics or pharma partners without explicit consent.
- Users can pause dayli with STOP, or request deletion with DELETE, on WhatsApp.

## Languages

dayli's website and product guidance are fully translated into four languages. Each page below is published as four URL variants, one per language. English is served at the root; other languages are served at a path prefix that matches their ISO 639-1 code. Page-level `hreflang` alternates and JSON-LD `inLanguage` declarations are emitted on every variant.

- English (en) — served at `/` (default; also referenced as `x-default` in alternates)
- Hindi / हिंदी (hi, hreflang `hi-IN`) — served under `/hi`
- Telugu / తెలుగు (te, hreflang `te-IN`) — served under `/te`
- Arabic / العربية (ar, right-to-left) — served under `/ar`
